cmd:
cat > /tmp/scan.py <<'PYEOF'
import importlib.util, numpy as np, sys
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("vf","/opt/weather-pipeline/repo/scripts/icon_front_very_far_snapshot.py")
vf=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(vf)
run_dt,lead0=vf.find_latest_run_lead()
print("run",run_dt,"lead0",lead0)
for lead in range(6,79,6):
    url=vf.build_url(run_dt,lead,"pmsl","single-level",None,"PMSL")
    res,meta=vf.download_and_parse(url,"pmsl_scan")
    if res is None:
        print(lead,"нет данных",str(meta)[:80]); continue
    g,la,lo=res; p=g/100.0
    cs=vf.find_pressure_centers(p,None,la,lo)
    out=[]
    for c in cs:
        if c[2]!="L": continue
        dl=900/111.32; dlo=dl/np.cos(np.radians(c[0]))
        inside=(la.min()+dl<=c[0]<=la.max()-dl) and (lo.min()+dlo<=c[1]<=lo.max()-dlo)
        out.append((round(c[0],1),round(c[1],1),round(c[3],1),"IN" if inside else "edge"))
    print(lead,"valid",(run_dt+__import__("datetime").timedelta(hours=lead)).strftime("%d.%m %H"),"L:",out,flush=True)
PYEOF
cd /opt/weather-pipeline/repo && (nohup python3 /tmp/scan.py > /tmp/scan.log 2>&1 &); sleep 1; echo started
